summary: System experienced payment processing failures (500), service unavailability (503), and a brute-force login attempt.
root_causes: Downstream payment gateway timeouts or database locking causing 500 errors
Resource exhaustion or upstream dependency failure causing 503 errors
Credential stuffing attack triggering rate limits
recommendations: Investigate payment service stack traces and database performance
Check health and resources of dashboard and reporting microservices
Implement circuit breakers for external payment gateways
Block suspicious IP address attempting brute-force login
